text: {"lessons":["My account rose and fell despite little trading, reminding me that short-term market moves are unpredictable and recent changes are not reliable signals.","Selling profitable shares was easier than confronting a losing position; I should judge every holding by its future prospects, not my purchase price or reluctance to admit a mistake.","Frequent checking can tempt me to react to noise, so I should make deliberate decisions and trade only when there is a clear reason."]}
